name: Tempest Call
description: The Pitsorcer calls down a storm that hammers a wide stretch of the pit.

effects.text: Tempest Call strikes every foe caught in the storm.
Lightning arcs to two more foes.

runes.name: Eye of the Storm
runes.description: The storm spreads wider and longer, but its heart is less violent.

runes.name: Surge
runes.description: The whole storm is condensed into one violent overload.

runes.name: Veiled Storm
runes.description: A quieter storm that costs a fortune of Arcane but comes back sooner.

name: Frost Nova
description: A ring of killing cold erupts outward and locks every enemy in place.

effects.text: Frost Nova freezes every foe in the ring.

runes.name: Deep Freeze
runes.description: A deeper frost that reaches further and holds its victims longer.

runes.name: Shatter
runes.description: The nova is aimed to break frozen bodies rather than merely still them.

name: Chain Lightning
description: A bolt of lightning leaps from foe to foe through the whole pit room.

effects.text: The bolt strikes the chosen foe.
The bolt leaps to three more foes.

runes.name: Overload
runes.description: The bolt is charged past its limit and burns through far more Arcane.

runes.name: Spark
runes.description: A lighter bolt that snaps back into the caster's hand almost at once.

name: Arcane Blink
description: The Pitsorcer steps through the veil and reappears with sharpened focus.

effects.text: A third of the Arcane pool returns with the spell.
Focus: critical strikes land more often.

runes.name: Phase Step
runes.description: A shorter step through the veil that returns even more Arcane.

runes.name: Veil of Focus
runes.description: A longer step that leaves the Pitsorcer perfectly focused for longer.

name: Sunder
description: A splitting ray that tears the armour of a single foe apart.

effects.text: The wounded foe strikes far weaker.

runes.name: Rift
runes.description: A deeper split that opens the target up at a heavy cost of Arcane.

runes.name: Fracture
runes.description: A quicker split whose wound keeps the target weakened far longer.
